annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it explains a payment-based Forsage X4 plan involving purchased smart contracts, participant payments, upline labels, and bringing another person onto the plan. The speaker encourages viewers to post and put effort into the plan while saying it will pay off, making the payment discussion an encouragement to participate rather than a neutral explanation.
